enunciado: Ask for a grade between 0 and 100. While the value read is not valid, show "invalid" and read again. Finally show the accepted grade and how many attempts were needed.
objetivos: Use do { } while (...) when the body must run at least once
pistas: In do-while the condition is checked at the end.
The repeat condition is: grade < 0 || grade > 100.
Count every read, valid or not.
